risk_note: RV2 ledger (B2-02r; BR-FUND-19). Daily-check chain healing: the worker timer uses healDailyCheck, which re-sends (app, D) unless the queue / results show it completed or already created / retry / active (no in-process memory, survives restarts), so a daily job that exhausted its retries into ledger-check.dead no longer silently stops the chain; seedDailyCheck is kept as frozen by B2-02q. An overdue (app, D) (no completion past D+1 01:00 + grace) logs one alert per (app, D), claimed durably in app.processed_events (consumer ledger.daily_check_overdue_alert, deterministic uuid; INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; no migration). Clock only.
